title: Design Process
description: A structured process for developing, testing, evaluating, and refining a design.

children.label: Analysis
children.description: Study the existing conditions, context, users, opportunities, and constraints before making design decisions.

children.label: Site Analysis
children.description: Understand the physical, environmental, spatial, and contextual characteristics of the site.

children.label: Physical Analysis
children.description: Study site dimensions, topography, existing structures, access, circulation, vegetation, edges, and physical features.

children.label: Environmental Analysis
children.description: Study climate, sun, wind, rainfall, drainage, ecology, microclimate, and other environmental conditions.

children.label: User Analysis
children.description: Understand users, their activities, behaviours, needs, expectations, and patterns of use.

children.label: Problem Definition
children.description: Convert the findings from analysis into clearly defined design problems and priorities.

children.label: Ideation
children.description: Generate and develop possible design responses to the identified problems and opportunities.
